Nowruz

A Day of Renewal: Celebrating Nowruz at Home

Welcome the Persian New Year with a day dedicated to springtime renewal, family connection, and delicious feasting, all from the comfort of your home. This agenda guides you through the joyful traditions of Nowruz.

  1. Morning

    A Fresh Start

    Begin your Nowruz day with a sense of renewal by tidying your home, symbolizing a fresh start for the new year and embracing the spirit of spring cleaning.

  2. Late Morning

    Adorn Your Haft-Seen

    Take a moment to admire or put the finishing touches on your Haft-Seen table, a beautiful arrangement of symbolic items representing spring, life, and prosperity for the year ahead.

  3. Noon

    A Sweet Welcome

    As the day unfolds, enjoy a moment of quiet celebration with a warm cup of tea and traditional sweets, preparing your palate for the festivities ahead.

    Recipes: Classic Brewed Black Tea · Nan-e Berenji (Persian Rice Cookies)

  4. Afternoon

    Connect with Loved Ones

    Reach out to family and friends, sharing well wishes and the joy of Nowruz, whether through calls, video chats, or preparing for a small, safe gathering.

  5. Evening

    The Nowruz Feast

    Gather for a festive dinner, enjoying the vibrant flavors of spring with herb-forward dishes and celebratory rice, marking the abundance and blessings of the new year.

    Recipes: Kookoo Sabzi (Persian Herb Frittata) · Sabzi Polo (Persian Herbed Rice)

  6. After Dinner

    Sweet Endings

    Wind down your celebratory day with more comforting tea and delightful sweets, reflecting on the joy and renewal that Nowruz brings to your home.

    Recipes: Classic Brewed Black Tea · Nan-e Berenji (Persian Rice Cookies)

May your home be filled with peace, prosperity, and the vibrant spirit of spring this Nowruz and throughout the new year.
